changes.detail: LRUCache.get moves the key it reads to the most-recent end, so entries you read are protected from eviction
get_or_compute checks the raw Redis value against None instead of checking whether the decoded value is truthy, so 0, '', [], {}, False and a cached null are served from the cache
dumps uses a default hook that turns datetime/date/time into ISO 8601 strings; other unsupported types still raise TypeError
Added a FakeRedis client and a parametrized get_or_compute falsy-value test that runs without a Redis server; moved imports to the top

testing.note: after the fixes and new tests

testing.command: git stash push kvcache/redis_cache.py && python -m pytest -q tests/test_redis_cache.py && git stash pop
testing.note: expected result: confirms the new tests fail without the redis_cache fix
final run after restoring the fix

side_effects.detail: Redis is not running here, so the 3 @requires_redis tests in tests/test_redis_cache.py were skipped. The get_or_compute fix was checked with a FakeRedis client instead, not a real server.
Briefly used git stash on kvcache/redis_cache.py to confirm the new tests fail without the fix, then restored it.

summary: Fixed all three issues. get_or_compute now caches falsy values by checking for a key miss (raw value is None) instead of whether the value is truthy. LRUCache.get now updates recency. serializers.dumps writes datetime/date/time as ISO 8601 strings. The existing failing tests now pass, and a test that runs without Redis covers the get_or_compute fix. Final run: 50 passed, 3 skipped (the skipped tests need a live Redis).
